title: GAD: Geometry Attention Distillation for Consistent Video Generation
title_zh: 几何注意力蒸馏（Geometry Attention Distillation, GAD）方法

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种几何注意力蒸馏方法，用于生成一致的视频序列。 Video diffusion models generate visually compelling short-term sequences but often struggle to preserve scene geometry and object structure over time. In this paper, we first demonstrate that current video attention cannot identify reliable correspondences across frames, with responses dispersed across multiple regions even after recognizable scene structure has emerged. We argue that reliable cross-frame associations are essential for information exchange as scene structure forms in video generation. Thus, we introduce Geometry Attention Distillation (GAD), which transfers correspondences from a frozen geometry model's attention to video attention. Extracted from clean videos, these correspondences link the same static surface or moving object across frames. Since structure formation begins in deeper layers at higher noise and shallower layers at lower noise, we apply attention distillation at a student layer selected according to the noise timestep. After training, video attention focuses more consistently on corresponding locations. Experiments across all three video backbones demonstrate improved long-range scene consistency and dynamic temporal consistency, with geometric gains across generation lengths. On Wan2.2 5B, GAD improves cross-frame matching accuracy by at least 30% over the Wan baseline on both long-range benchmarks. Notably, GAD achieves these gains without additional inference modules, offering a promising approach to efficient and consistent video-based world simulation. Project page: https://fantasy-amap.github.io/GAD/.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种几何注意力蒸馏方法，用于生成一致的视频序列。视频扩散模型能够生成视觉上令人信服短期序列，但往往难以在时间维度上保持场景几何和物体结构的稳定性。 在本文中，我们首先证明当前的视频注意力机制无法识别帧之间的可靠对应关系，即使可识别的场景结构已经出现，其响应仍会分散到多个区域。 我们认为，在视频生成过程中，随着场景结构的形成，可靠的跨帧关联对于信息交换至关重要。 因此，我们引入了几何注意力蒸馏（Geometry Attention Distillation, GAD），该方法将冻结几何模型中的注意力对应关系迁移至视频注意力中。 这些对应关系从清晰视频中提取，能够连接同一静态表面或移动物体在不同帧中的位置。 由于结构形成始于较高噪声下的更深层以及较低噪声下的更浅层，我们根据噪声时间步选择学生层来应用注意力蒸馏。 训练后，视频注意力能更稳定地聚焦于对应的区域位置。 在三种不同视频骨干网络上的实验表明，该方法提升了长距离场景一致性和动态时间一致性，并在各种生成长度下带来了几何结构的改进。 在 Wan2.2 5B 模型上，GAD 在长距离基准测试中使跨帧匹配准确率相比 Wan 基线模型至少提升了 30%。 值得注意的是，GAD 无需额外的推理模块即可实现这些提升，为高效且一致的视频化世界模拟提供了一种有前景的方法。 项目页面：https://fantasy-amap.github.io/GAD/。
